name: WaveSpeed MCP
description: Generate and edit images and videos with WaveSpeed's live model catalog from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client, with a price quote before each run, for creators and developers.

skills.name: Generate Image
skills.description: Generates an image from a text prompt with WaveSpeed's /chat image models, sending reference images to the model's edit endpoint.

skills.name: Generate Video
skills.description: Generates a video from a prompt, a first or last frame, or reference images, video and audio, with the /chat video models.

skills.name: Edit Images and Video
skills.description: Edits, restyles or combines existing images, and edits an existing video or continues it with new footage, with the /chat models.

skills.name: Run Any Model
skills.description: Runs any model in WaveSpeed's live catalog after reading its input schema, uploading local @path files automatically.

skills.name: Quote Price
skills.description: Estimates what a run will cost for the given inputs without charging, and reports the account's credit balance.
